summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) Team page hang fix, (2) Dashboard plans-section limit (home_plans_count=3), (3) Invest page cowrywise redesign + skeletons + invest-dialog. All three primary features render correctly on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (430x900). No live DB mutations performed.

issues: 'FROM' label is upper-cased via CSS (text-transform: uppercase) so the raw text node reads 'FROM ₦3,500.00' rather than 'From ₦3,500.00'. Visually matches the cowrywise spec; cosmetic only.

Pre-existing Radix console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) to invest-dialog and welcome-modal to silence. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional, a11y) Add <DialogDescription> / aria-describedby to invest-dialog and welcome-modal DialogContent to remove repeating Radix warnings.

(Not a bug, FYI) The plan-skeleton on /invest was not observed because the products API responds in <500ms in this environment; the SkeletonCard JSX is present in code and will render on slower networks. No fix needed.
